title: Chapter 6481: Why Are You Two Together?

Chapter 6481: Why Are You Two Together?

Chapter 6481: Why Are You Two Together?

Both healed in no time at all with Li Qiye’s help. He sat down while the two prostrated: “Thank you for saving us, Sacred Teacher. We will not forget this kindness.”

“So what happened here?” Li Qiye smiled.

The two exchanged glances and had a hint of shyness and love.

“Where do we begin?” He seemed amused since the two clearly had feelings for each other.

“Sit down, I’m sure you have a lot to say.” Li Qiye patted the ground.

The two sat before him and for some reason, looked like newlyweds. This was unsuitable for their status and temperament.

Creek King opened her mouth but hesitated, looking to be in a predicament. Li Qiye didn’t rush her.

Orchid Sage held her hands tightly as encouragement.

“Luminous Creek was destroyed.” She took a deep breath and said. Her hands trembled as she spoke.

Orchid Sage couldn’t help but place his hand on her shoulder, looking rather determined and full of love. The elegant ruler leaned against him, feeling safe despite having a broken heart.

“Yes, and two survivors.” Li Qiye said calmly.

Although this had happened long ago, it still felt like yesterday to her. It took a while before she regained enough composure to speak.

“Yes, two survivors.” She shuddered.

Luminous Master and her started the sect. It became one of the strongest in Three Immortals due to their cultivation and administrative prowess. Disciples roamed the world; many of whom were incredible geniuses.

They had no lack of emperors and desolate gods. Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers were present as well.

They became comparable to Five-element Mountain. Perhaps this was a slight exaggeration, a testament to their strength. However, something destroyed them in just one night. It should have taken far more time given their strength.

Rumor has it Luminous Master was the sole survivor and entered Supreme Heaven under a different guise. Those who knew lost contact with him with time.

He seemingly vanished from the world and people forgot about him. Today, there was another survivor - his spouse.

“Orchid saved me from death.” Her eyes lit up as she stared at Orchid. The pain deep in her heart slowly dissipated.

Both became determined as if nothing could stop them.

“Yes, he nearly threw his life away by doing so.” Li Qiye smiled.

As she was on the verge of death, Orchid Sage risked it all to save her. He essentially exchanged his life for hers, attempting to remove the evil presence.

Both suffered during the process but he never gave up. Everything he learned in life was for this moment alone. Fortunately, Li Qiye came just in time to save him.

His sacrifice and determination touched her, mending the broken pieces of her heart. Their love blossomed and became stronger.

“Sigh, I must have terrible karma to be subjected to this showering of affection.” Li Qiye shook his head and joked.

The two turned red but still stared at each other lovingly.

“The destruction didn’t fall from the sky.” Li Qiye said.

She took a deep breath and nodded: “Yes, the seed was planted upon the sect’s foundation.”
